description: This file defines the MySQLSaver class, which manages checkpoint storage and retrieval in a MySQL database for a memory component in a language processing system. It includes methods for database setup, CRUD operations on checkpoints, and chat message handling.

classes.name: MySQLSaver
classes.description: A class that handles saving, retrieving, listing, and deleting checkpoint data in a MySQL database, and manages chat messages associated with sessions.

methods.name: sanitizeTableName
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates the table name to ensure it contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Initializes and returns a TypeORM DataSource based on configuration options.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Creates the checkpoints table in the database if it does not exist.

methods.name: getTuple
methods.description: Retrieves a checkpoint tuple from the database based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists checkpoint tuples with optional limit and pagination.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a checkpoint and its metadata into the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes all checkpoints associated with a given thread ID.

methods.name: getChatMessages
methods.description: Fetches chat messages for a specific session, optionally returning base message format and prepending messages.

methods.name: clearChatMessages
methods.description: Deletes chat messages for a specific session.
